ref.description: Exact committed Ref; copy every field byte-exact from the request, never retype or shorten it

sha256.description: Full lowercase 64-hex-character sha256 of the referenced contract

manifest_sha256.description: Full lowercase 64-hex-character sha256 of the referenced manifest

evidence.description: A cited kind=evidence file. ref null cites this contract's own files[]; otherwise ref is one of the Step's citable inputs and file_id is that input's files[] id

file_id.description: Bare files[] id, never a path or a name with an added extension

gap_id.description: Gap id: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, unique within the contract that declares the gap

gap.description: Work that remains undone or failed; a genuine absence confirmed from evidence is not a gap
